label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: SGR pays Shs373bn for land
stories.story: Government has paid Shs373.07 billion to 7,721 people for SGR land. Another 5,225 are still owed Shs472.45 billion.
stories.you: Families along the line have cash to spend. Show them plots and homes to buy with it.

stories.title: Kampala shops shut in tax strike
stories.story: Traders shut shops from Owino to Kisekka on 17 Nov. KACITA has called a month-long shutdown over taxes and customs. Talks with government go on.
stories.you: Letting shops in town? Wait for the talks before you agree a rent. Tenants are under strain.
stories.source: Sources: Pulse Uganda, Galaxy FM · 17–18 Nov 2026

stories.title: Court halts Shs189bn payout
stories.story: The High Court stopped a Shs189 billion payment to Madhvani for land at Nakigalala, Wakiso, wanted for an innovation city. A family’s case covers 948.15 acres.
stories.you: Selling near Nakigalala? Don’t promise the innovation city — court cases may delay it.

stories.title: 12 acres grabbed in Kawanda
stories.story: DP leader Kiwanuka Mayambala Ssempala says armed men took more than 12 acres of his family’s land in Kawanda, using forged titles.
stories.you: Fake titles are out there. Check the title at the land office before your client pays a deposit.

stories.title: Kayunga land clash with Buganda
stories.story: Kayunga’s district chairperson says he bought land and got a title in 2024, after Land Board clearance. Buganda Kingdom says it is the Kabaka’s land.
stories.you: A title can still be fought over. On kingdom land, check with Buganda Land Board too.
